# user-monitoring

User Workload Monitoring: Prometheus, Thanos Ruler and Alertmanager for application metrics

```yaml
stack:
  userMonitoring:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Retention and storage sizing, the values most likely to differ per cluster

Under `stack.userMonitoring.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `storageClass` | Default StorageClass for every UWM component. Omit to use the cluster default. | `''` |
| `prometheus` |  |  |
| `prometheus.retention` | How long application metrics are kept | `24h` |
| `prometheus.storage` | PVC size for each Prometheus replica | `50Gi` |
| `prometheus.storageClass` | Override the StorageClass for Prometheus only | `''` |
| `prometheus.resources` | Optional resource requests/limits | `{}` |
| `prometheus.dedicatedServiceMonitors` | Give each ServiceMonitor its own Prometheus shard | `false` |
| `thanosRuler` |  |  |
| `thanosRuler.retention` | How long ruler data is kept | `24h` |
| `thanosRuler.storage` | PVC size for each Thanos Ruler replica | `10Gi` |
| `thanosRuler.storageClass` | Override the StorageClass for Thanos Ruler only | `''` |
| `thanosRuler.resources` |  | `{}` |
| `alertmanager` |  |  |
| `alertmanager.enabled` | Run a dedicated Alertmanager for user workloads | `false` |
| `alertmanager.storage` | PVC size for each Alertmanager replica | `10Gi` |
| `alertmanager.storageClass` | Override the StorageClass for Alertmanager only | `''` |
| `alertmanager.resources` |  | `{}` |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: AU-6 Audit Review, Analysis, and Reporting. Categories: AU Audit and Accountability.

### Policy `config`

`config-user-monitoring-<cluster>`: Enable and configure User Workload Monitoring.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config-enable` | enforce | [uwm-enable](converters/uwm-enable.yaml) | Enable UWM and write its configuration |

### Policy `ready`

`ready-user-monitoring-<cluster>`: Reports NonCompliant until the UWM StatefulSets are ready. Depends on `config-user-monitoring-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ready-statefulsets` | inform | [uwm-ready](converters/uwm-ready.yaml) | UWM StatefulSet readiness |
